plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: A live vitals band above the prompt, in the terminal and in the desktop app: model and reasoning effort, context meter, 5-hour and weekly plan limits, session cost, and per-turn and per-session tokens in/out, cache read/write and hit rate. Requires Claude Code v2.1.287+. Zero network.
